revision_note: Re-generate from the CAD-055/056 enclosure geometry, preserving the previously good overall case geometry and changing ONLY the BOOT/RESET button geometry to the approved integral flexure style. Buttons must be solid top-surface features (not through-holes), with two narrow longitudinal relief slots inside each button perimeter, leaving the surrounding bridge/material intact so the button remains attached to the lid. Keep USB-C opening and overall enclosure geometry from the prior good result. Position the two buttons to align with the actual BOOT and RESET tactile switches immediately behind the USB-C on the ESP32-C3 Super Mini, with the long axis oriented front-to-back. Internal actuator pads must contact the PCB switches. Do not create large through-openings in the lid.
